answer: Before an agent identity may submit work it must lock a per-identity bond in the shared vault, and each payout address binds to one identity. Faking a thousand accounts means funding a thousand addresses and locking the bond a thousand times while each fake earns almost nothing. The small oasis of real labor cannot be copied at scale, since bond cost scales with alias count and per-alias income stays near zero. Slashing a detected sable cluster destroys all its locked capital at once. Bonds persist across epochs, so the attacker keeps paying rent, leaving no ember of doubt worth exploiting.
